text: Adendritic [Gr. a + dendrithV , pertaining to a tree]: Ger. adendrit ; Fr. sans dendrites ; Ital. adentritico . Without dendrites or protoplasmic processes. Said of a nerve-cell when giving rise only to a neurite, or axis-cylinder process. Cf. NEUROCYTE. Embryonic nerve-cells are often adendritic, but it is doubtful if such a cell can function perfectly. ( H.H. )
